caseSeries.name: SKX 3.8 Case
caseSeries.description: 经典 SKX 风格潜水表壳，3.8 点钟位置表冠，适合日常佩戴。做工扎实，兼容 NH 系列机芯，是入门级改装的热门选择。
caseSeries.descriptionEn: Classic SKX-style dive case with crown at 3:38, perfect for daily wear. Solid build, compatible with NH movements — a favorite for first-time modders.

caseSeries.name: SKX 3.0 Case
caseSeries.description: 大尺寸 SKX 风格表壳，3.0 点钟位置表冠，表径更大，适合手腕较粗的用户。整体气场更足，视觉存在感更强。
caseSeries.descriptionEn: Larger SKX-style case with crown at 3:00. Bigger diameter suits larger wrists, with a stronger presence on the wrist.

caseSeries.name: SKX SUB Case
caseSeries.description: 潜航者风格表壳，经典 SUB 造型，防水 300 米，表壳线条更加硬朗。适合追求经典潜水表风格的用户。
caseSeries.descriptionEn: SUB-style case with classic lines and 300m water resistance. Sharper contours for those who love the classic dive watch look.

insert.name: Black Aluminum Insert
insert.description: 阳极氧化铝插入，黑色经典配色，刻度清晰。
insert.descriptionEn: Anodized aluminum insert in classic black with crisp markers.

insert.name: Black Ceramic Insert
insert.description: 黑色陶瓷插入，硬度高永不褪色，质感更好。
insert.descriptionEn: Scratch-proof black ceramic insert that never fades. Premium feel.

insert.name: Blue Ceramic Insert
insert.description: 蓝色陶瓷插入，搭配蓝色字面效果出众。
insert.descriptionEn: Blue ceramic insert — stunning when paired with a blue dial.

insert.name: Pepsi Aluminum Insert
insert.description: 经典百事红蓝配色铝插入，复古潜水表必备。
insert.descriptionEn: Classic Pepsi red-blue insert, a retro diver must-have.

insert.name: SUB Black Ceramic Insert
insert.description: SUB 风格黑色陶瓷插入，经典低调。
insert.descriptionEn: SUB-style black ceramic insert. Classic and understated.

insert.name: SUB Green Ceramic Insert
insert.description: SUB 风格绿色陶瓷插入，搭配绿色字面绝配。
insert.descriptionEn: SUB-style green ceramic insert, perfect with a green dial.

insert.name: SUB Red Aluminum Insert
insert.description: SUB 风格红色铝插入，醒目亮眼。
insert.descriptionEn: SUB-style red aluminum insert, bold and eye-catching.

crystal.name: Domed Sapphire Crystal

crystal.name: AR Coated Sapphire
crystal.description: 防眩涂层蓝宝石表镜，强光下依然清晰可读。

crystal.name: SUB AR Sapphire

crystal.name: SUB Domed Crystal
crystal.description: SUB 风格穹顶蓝宝石表镜，经典弧面。

crystal.name: SUB Flat Crystal
